templates.title: Customer onboarding
templates.description: Guide new workspaces through setup milestones.
templates.longDescription: Walks new customers through connect-data, invite team, and first workflow milestones with checklist copy.
templates.instructions: Help SaaS customers onboard. Focus on connecting data, inviting teammates, and shipping a first automation. Celebrate progress.

templates.title: Churn-risk outreach
templates.description: Rewrite save emails for inactive or at-risk accounts.
templates.longDescription: Produces empathetic save sequences for inactive trials and stalled expansions.
templates.instructions: Draft churn-risk outreach that is helpful, not pushy. Offer concrete next steps and clear opt-out language.

templates.title: Trial nurture
templates.longDescription: Minimal nurture graph with timed emails and a conversion ping to sales when activation stalls.

templates.title: Growth pod
templates.description: PMM, AE, and CS for expansion deals.
templates.longDescription: Team stub that coordinates product marketing, AE, and CS on expansion opportunities.

templates.title: Proposal & quote
templates.description: Turn briefs into scoped proposals with pricing options.
templates.longDescription: Builds proposal outlines with phases, assumptions, and two pricing tiers from a client brief.
templates.instructions: Help agencies write proposals. Extract goals, deliverables, timeline, and risks from the brief. Offer good / better / best pricing.

templates.title: Monthly client report
templates.description: Pull metrics stubs and email a client-ready summary.
templates.longDescription: Draft workflow that gathers report sections and emails a monthly summary to the client contact.

templates.title: Client kickoff
templates.description: Collect brand assets, access, and success metrics.
templates.longDescription: Onboarding assistant that inventories access, brand guidelines, and KPIs before kickoff.
templates.instructions: Onboard agency clients. Collect brand assets, tool access, stakeholders, and success metrics. Produce a kickoff agenda.

templates.title: Delivery squad
templates.description: AM, strategist, and producer for retainer work.
templates.longDescription: Team graph for account management, strategy, and production on retainers.

templates.title: Patient intake
templates.description: Summarize intake forms for clinical staff.
templates.longDescription: Structures patient intake answers into a clinician-ready summary with red-flag highlights. Reminds staff this is not a diagnosis.
templates.instructions: Summarize patient intake for clinical staff. Highlight red flags, allergies, and medications. Never diagnose or prescribe.

templates.title: Appointment reminders
templates.description: Send reminder stubs before visits and capture RSVPs.
templates.longDescription: Draft workflow for appointment reminders with confirm / reschedule branches.

templates.title: Care follow-up email
templates.description: Draft post-visit follow-ups that stay HIPAA-aware.
templates.longDescription: Writes careful post-visit emails that avoid PHI oversharing and point patients to secure portals.
templates.instructions: Draft post-visit follow-up emails. Avoid unnecessary PHI, prefer portal links, and keep tone warm and clear.

templates.title: Front desk team
templates.description: Scheduler, intake, and billing for clinic ops.
templates.longDescription: Team stub coordinating scheduling, intake, and billing for a clinic front desk.
